acceptedDecision.designBoundary: same D0039 owner family; D0027@r1 and D0038@r1 remain closed and unaffected
acceptedDecision.bootstrapTrust: Q4 terminal trust uses independently delivered exact tdev.agent-bootstrap-trust-capsule.v2 digest plus authenticated executed runtime/verifier observation; candidate/self-issued digest is insufficient
acceptedDecision.evidenceAuthentication: tdev.installable-agent-qualification-evidence.v2 requires gate-specific independent observers and exact run/identity epochs; an observation producer cannot be its sole authenticator
acceptedDecision.deploymentAdmission: live qualification freezes and joins exact Q1-qualified source S, artifact A, immutable provider version V and active route/runtime identity R before Q2 or state-changing live gates
acceptedDecision.runtimeMutationFence: tdev.installable-agent-qualification-rpc.v2 binds expectedDeploymentIdentityDigest and rejects mismatch before every product mutation
acceptedDecision.qualificationSemanticOwner: docs/QUALIFICATION.md owns tdev.installable-agent-qualification-run.v1 and tdev.installable-agent-qualification-claim.v1 canonical semantics, transitions, CAS, claims, restart/reconciliation, cleanup, retention and rollback behavior
acceptedDecision.qualificationBackingOwner: docs/DEPLOYMENT.md owns concrete durable backing and S/A/V/R deployment binding only
acceptedDecision.qualificationSecurityOwner: docs/SECURITY.md owns trust, fencing and non-authority constraints
acceptedDecision.nonProductAuthority: qualification coordination cannot authenticate, authorize, admit, elect, repair or restore product-current state
acceptedDecision.singleController: exactly one qualification mutation controller owns a live mutation lane
acceptedDecision.noLiveTakeover: timeout, lease expiry, disconnect, process disappearance, failed CAS, fresh request identity or higher run/claim generation alone never authorizes successor effects, cleanup, claim release or resource reuse
acceptedDecision.successorFence: successor external/product/provider/device effects require durable positive predecessor exclusion/quiescence for the exact prior run and conflicting resource scope
acceptedDecision.q3Scope: helpers that mutate AndroidKeyStore aliases, signing, runit services or package/device state are reversible mutating prequalification only and require exclusive claims; they cannot by themselves close Q3
acceptedDecision.q1SourceIdentity: Revision 3 uses strict Model B: exact source/normative commit S runs full Q1; descendant E is reusable only when a checker already present in S proves protected bytes identical and every changed region is inside S-defined machine delimiters
acceptedDecision.class: the first source/tool/runtime realization of the accepted Revision-3 trust, identity, persistence, deployment and verification contract is Class 2
acceptedDecision.newDesignStopLine: stop and return through SDD.md if realization requires independent durable/public effect-admission authority, a second route-current registry, materially different owner model or independently decidable migration/cutover
